repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 30-second sustain window (300 ticks at 100ms). The candidate uses a 1000ms period and a threshold of 30, causing the action to fire after 30 seconds of 1000ms ticks (30s) but incorrectly counting the initial state as tick 1, leading to an early trigger at 29s (29 ticks of 1000ms). The evidence shows the IR waits until 30000ms, while the JoI acts at 29000ms. The fix requires a 100ms period and a threshold of 301 (300 ticks + 1 for the initial state).
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period from 1000 to 100 to match the sustain grid. Updated the threshold from 30 to 301 to correctly count 30 full seconds (300 ticks) plus the initial tick, ensuring the action fires exactly at 30000ms as required by the IR.
